verdict: Maybe. Offmint from Samastipur got a deal from five sharks on Shark Tank India Season 4, showing luxury-style fashion can come from small towns. But luxury needs high standards in every detail, and the brand story must justify the price.
angle: Aspiring buyers in smaller cities want premium fashion at reachable prices. A luxury-feel brand needs premium fabrics, packaging and customer service. Sales are fewer but each one is larger, so every detail of the experience matters.
